questions.text: Has your employer implemented a new or stricter return-to-office policy in the past 12 months?
On a scale of 1-100, how much do you trust that your company’s RTO policy is genuinely about 'culture and productivity' rather than reducing headcount?
Do you believe this mandate is a "Stealth Layoff" designed to make people quit so the company can avoid paying severance?
Have you engaged in "Coffee Badging" (going into the office just to swipe your badge/be seen, then leaving early) to meet the requirement?
options: My office tracks my hours too strictly

questions.text: Which of the following have you done since the mandate was announced? (Select all that apply)
options: Applied for a new job while at my office desk
Started a side hustle for extra security
